nodes.name: Filas de asociaciones (reemplazar por lectura de Excel)

parameters.query:
-- Una sola sentencia = una sola transacción (commit implícito).
-- Se ejecuta una vez por fila (item) que entra.
-- Parámetros:
--   $1 ID_GRUPO_PROVEEDOR (→ groups_prov.external_id)
--   $2 ID_PROVEEDOR       (→ users.internal_id)
WITH input AS (
    SELECT
        NULLIF($1::text, '') AS group_external_id,
        NULLIF($2::text, '') AS provider_internal_id
),
-- Resuelve los UUIDs reales a partir de los identificadores del Excel.
resolved AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT g.id FROM public.groups_prov g WHERE g.external_id = i.group_external_id)    AS group_id,
        (SELECT u.id FROM public.users u WHERE u.internal_id = i.provider_internal_id AND u.is_sales = FALSE) AS provider_id,
        i.group_external_id,
        i.provider_internal_id,
        -- external_id de la asociación = combinación de ambos ids del Excel
        -- (trazable e idempotente). Cámbialo si tu Excel trae un id propio.
        i.group_external_id || '::' || i.provider_internal_id AS external_id
    FROM input i
),
-- Upsert de la asociación. Conflicto por la PK real (group_id, provider_id).
upsert_link AS (
    INSERT INTO public.group_provider (group_id, provider_id, external_id)
    SELECT group_id, provider_id, external_id
    FROM resolved
    WHERE group_id IS NOT NULL AND provider_id IS NOT NULL
    ON CONFLICT (group_id, provider_id) DO UPDATE
        SET external_id = EXCLUDED.external_id
    RETURNING *
)
-- Todo en un solo objeto (incluye la resolución para depurar filas sin match).
SELECT json_build_object(
    'group_provider', (SELECT row_to_json(l) FROM upsert_link l),
    'resolved',       (SELECT row_to_json(r) FROM resolved r)
) AS result;
